summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Sibanye Stillwater Limited, a foreign private issuer, submitted to the SEC on May 4, 2026, for the purpose of furnishing a market release (Exhibit 99.1). The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, or activist campaign. It is merely a periodic report of material information, likely operational or financial in nature, without any binding transaction terms or advisory recommendations. No deal terms, premium, or strategic review are disclosed, and the filing does not trigger a special-situations classification.
